rationale: Record that a release runner-routing change crosses the design-output-and-packaging selector through the release workflows (release-cli.yml, sign-and-release.yml, release-path-pr-gate.yml). An opt-in repo variable, PULP_RELEASE_CLASS_TOKENS, appends a release class label to a self-hosted macOS runs-on selector; unset, every workflow dispatches today's selector byte-for-byte. Only which runner a release job is scheduled on can change. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold, packaging artifact or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
